patch.author: ryan@ryanmerrill.net
patch.comment: Enable tree-shaking support by outputting individual ESM modules instead of a single bundled file. Consumers importing individual icons will now only include those icons in their bundle (~4KB each) instead of the entire library (3.3MB). No API changes.
